cards.back:
Belonging to them.
Bahasa Indonesia: milik mereka
Example: The pupils put their bags on the hooks by the door.
cards.say: their. The pupils put their bags on the hooks by the door.

cards.back:
In that place.
Bahasa Indonesia: di sana
Example: Put the box over there, next to the window.
cards.say: there. Put the box over there, next to the window.

cards.back:
A short way to say they are.
Bahasa Indonesia: mereka adalah
Example: They're coming to our house for a big lunch on Saturday.
cards.say: they're. They're coming to our house for a big lunch on Saturday.

cards.back:
Belonging to you.
Bahasa Indonesia: milikmu
Example: Please bring your pencil case to the art lesson tomorrow.
cards.say: your. Please bring your pencil case to the art lesson tomorrow.

cards.back:
A short way to say you are.
Bahasa Indonesia: kamu adalah
Example: You're very good at drawing animals and birds.
cards.say: you're. You're very good at drawing animals and birds.

cards.back:
Belonging to it.
Bahasa Indonesia: miliknya
Example: The dog wagged its tail when we came home.
cards.say: its. The dog wagged its tail when we came home.

cards.back:
A short way to say it is or it has.
Bahasa Indonesia: itu adalah
Example: It's a lovely day, so let us eat outside.
cards.say: it's. It's a lovely day, so let us eat outside.

cards.back:
A word that shows direction or comes before a verb.
Bahasa Indonesia: ke
Example: We went to the park to fly our kites.
cards.say: to. We went to the park to fly our kites.

cards.back:
Also, or more than is needed.
Bahasa Indonesia: juga, terlalu
Example: The soup is too hot, and the tea is hot too.
cards.say: too. The soup is too hot, and the tea is hot too.

cards.back:
The number 2.
Bahasa Indonesia: dua
Example: I have two brothers and one sister who live in Bandung.
cards.say: two. I have two brothers and one sister who live in Bandung.

cards.back:
To change or have an influence on something.
Bahasa Indonesia: memengaruhi
Example: Heavy rain can affect the way people travel to school.
cards.say: affect. Heavy rain can affect the way people travel to school.

cards.back:
A result of something.
Bahasa Indonesia: akibat
Example: The medicine had a good effect and the cough soon stopped.
cards.say: effect. The medicine had a good effect and the cough soon stopped.

cards.back:
To agree to take something.
Bahasa Indonesia: menerima
Example: She was happy to accept the gift from her aunt.
cards.say: accept. She was happy to accept the gift from her aunt.

cards.back:
Not including.
Bahasa Indonesia: kecuali
Example: Everyone except Tom has finished the reading test.
cards.say: except. Everyone except Tom has finished the reading test.

cards.back:
Making very little noise.
Bahasa Indonesia: tenang
Example: The library is a quiet place to read.
cards.say: quiet. The library is a quiet place to read.

cards.back:
Fairly or rather.
Bahasa Indonesia: cukup
Example: The film was quite long, but I enjoyed it.
cards.say: quite. The film was quite long, but I enjoyed it.

cards.back:
The head of a school, or the most important.
Bahasa Indonesia: kepala sekolah
Example: The principal welcomed the new teachers to the school.
cards.say: principal. The principal welcomed the new teachers to the school.

cards.back:
A rule or belief about what is right.
Bahasa Indonesia: prinsip
Example: Telling the truth is a principle my parents taught me.
cards.say: principle. Telling the truth is a principle my parents taught me.

cards.back:
A word used to show a choice between two things.
Bahasa Indonesia: apakah
Example: I wonder whether it will rain on Saturday.
cards.say: whether. I wonder whether it will rain on Saturday.

cards.back:
The daily condition of the air, such as sun or rain.
Bahasa Indonesia: cuaca
Example: The weather today is warm with a light breeze.
cards.say: weather. The weather today is warm with a light breeze.

cards.back:
To fail to keep something or fail to win.
Bahasa Indonesia: kehilangan, kalah
Example: Do not lose your ticket on the way to the zoo.
cards.say: lose. Do not lose your ticket on the way to the zoo.

cards.back:
Not tight or not fixed firmly.
Bahasa Indonesia: longgar
Example: The loose tooth finally fell out at lunchtime.
cards.say: loose. The loose tooth finally fell out at lunchtime.
